alt: 學生誇口說紙風車小車能載一大堆書，兩名同學看著桌上只放一本書的小車，露出懷疑神情。
scene_prompt: Meaning: 言過其實 means a claim exaggerates and does not match reality. A student enthusiastically boasts that his tiny handmade paper windmill-powered car can carry a mountain of books; in the foreground the real small paper car sits beside only one thin notebook and a gentle desk fan, while a large fanciful thought bubble shows an impossible mountain-sized stack atop it. Two classmates exchange skeptical but kind looks and point at the actual tiny car, showing mismatch between boast and fact. Keep boast visually fantastical only within thought bubble; real objects physically plausible, car wheels aligned and on desk. Three students, natural anatomy, exactly two arms and legs per visible person, hands attached and not merged. No visible writing; no answer text.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. NO readable text, letters, numerals, captions, logos, watermarks, brands or recognizable existing characters. Contemporary school science fair. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper; restrained natural colors, no 3D or glossy digital look.
